verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a README marketing line implying Firecrawl handles proxies for you ("no proxy headaches"). Nothing documents a rotating proxy IP pool or developer control over proxy routing. A community comment saying Firecrawl lacks a proxy service, likely about the open-source build, further lowers confidence. missing for 10: documentation of a rotating proxy pool, developer-configurable proxy/IP routing options, scope across cloud vs self-hosted, independent hands-on corroboration of block avoidance.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route requests through a rotating pool of proxy IPs to avoid blocks

citations.quote: Industry-leading reliability: Covers 96% of the web, including JS-heavy pages — no proxy headaches, just clean data
